p.src: Compounding only works if you avoid ruin. Insurance, diversification, liquidity buffers, and modest position sizing are not boring side notes. They are the conditions that allow compounding to survive.

p.src: Wealth growth = (earning power x savings rate x years x compounding x ownership share) - ruin
